title: Nyc South Asian Comedy Festival - Best Of Nyc
description: Experience the Best of NYC at the South Asian Comedy Festival
long_description:
Experience the Best of NYC at the South Asian Comedy Festival
Mark your calendars for the 16th of October, 2026 and get ready to experience a night filled with laughter, music, and entertainment. The NYC South Asian Comedy Festival - Best of NYC is all set to bring you a unique blend of Hindi music and comedy that promises to be the highlight of your evening. This event is not just about comedy, it's a full-fledged night party that you would not want to miss!
Meet the Star Comedian - Ali Mehedi
Ali Mehedi, the star comedian of the evening, is known for his unique comedic style that leaves audiences in splits. With performances at renowned platforms like the Absolute Comedy Club and Yuk Yuk's Comedy Club in Toronto, Gotham Comedy Club, Carolines on Broadway, New York Comedy Club, and Standup NY, his comedic journey is nothing short of phenomenal. His ability to tickle the funny bone is sure to be a delight for all attendees.
Welcome to the Scintillating LOFTE 23 NYC
Located at 22 West 23rd Street, New York, NY, United States, LOFTE 23 NYC is an event venue like no other. It boasts of not only safety and accessibility but also proximity to a host of nearby attractions. Parking won't be a hassle as ample space is available for attendees. And if you are an Indian food lover, make sure to explore the nearby Indian restaurants that serve mouth-watering delicacies.
Grab Your Tickets Now!
Ensure your presence at this comedy extravaganza by securing your tickets today. We offer a variety of ticket options to suit your preferences. The General Admission ticket, priced at $45.00, includes entry to both the Comedy Show and the Dance Party. If you are an early bird, you can get exclusive access to the After Party for just $20.00. Or you can choose to attend only the After Party with the General Admission ticket priced at $25.00. Don't wait, grab your tickets now!
